description: Tests that port trading is fully data-driven: adding a commodity to port_trade automatically enables trading without code changes

tests.name: T1.1: Insert new test commodity ALT (Alternate Tech)

sql: INSERT INTO commodities (code, name, illegal, base_price, volatility) VALUES ('ALT', 'Alternate Tech', false, 100, 25) ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING;

tests.name: T2.1: Attempt to trade ALT before adding to port_trade
T2.2: Add ALT to port 1 via port_trade

sql: INSERT INTO port_trade (port_id, commodity, mode, maxproduct) VALUES (1, 'ALT', 'sell', 1000) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

tests.name: T2.3: Ensure ALT has stock in entity_stock for port 1

sql: INSERT INTO entity_stock (entity_type, entity_id, commodity_code, quantity, price, last_updated_ts) VALUES ('port', 1, 'ALT', 100, 100, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (entity_type, entity_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity = 100, price = 100;

tests.name: T2.4: Buy ALT from port 1 - should work now without code changes
T2.5: Verify ALT in ship cargo
T3.1: Add ALT to port 1 for SELL mode (test sell path)

sql: INSERT INTO port_trade (port_id, commodity, mode, maxproduct) VALUES (1, 'ALT', 'buy', 500) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

tests.name: T3.2: Sell ALT to port 1 - should work via DB-driven trade path

sql: DELETE FROM port_trade WHERE port_id = 1 AND commodity = 'ALT';

tests.name: T4.2: Verify ALT no longer available at port 1
T5.1: Regression - Verify ORE still trades normally
T5.2: Regression - Verify illegal commodities still gated by alignment

assertions.name: Commodities table has ALT entry
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM commodities WHERE code = 'ALT' AND name = 'Alternate Tech';

assertions.name: port_trade has ALT configured dynamically
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM port_trade WHERE commodity = 'ALT' AND port_id = 1;

assertions.name: entity_stock has ALT stock for port
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type = 'port' AND commodity_code = 'ALT';
